g.title: INITWARN
g.text: Continue with warning; affected evidence unavailable

g.title: EXACT
g.text: Bank may contain metadata only when zero live overrides remain

g.title: FINPUNC
g.text: Paired segment-terminal source `―...―` subtitle bars receive surrounding spaces even before trailing sentence punctuation; ordinary bars stay tight

g.title: P1
g.text: Japanese 。、？！：； brackets/quotes etc. normalised to project output conventions

g.title: WIDTH
g.text: Targeted NFKC for half-width kana / full-width ASCII

g.title: WROW
g.text: Normalise obsolete W-row kana before tokenisation
ゐ→い / ヰ→イ / ゑ→え / ヱ→エ

g.title: WROWQ->TOKCHK
g.text: yes — preserve historical surface for T16 evidence

g.title: DEFKANA
g.text: Convert whatever is safely convertible directly

g.title: KURO
g.text: Kuromoji tokenises the COMPLETE normalised sentence
[M01 asset path + M11 build + Kuromoji dictionary]

g.title: TS0
g.text: Original source offsets are retained across every pass; Kuromoji boundaries are proposals, not final spans

g.title: TS1
g.text: 1 Restore dropped sokuon っ/ッ tokens
Runs immediately on the complete Kuromoji token stream while source positions still match the original normalised sentence

g.title: TS2
g.text: Retokenise only canonical hard-boundary segments; preserve whole-sentence context everywhere else

g.title: TS3A
g.text: Protect syntax-backed grammar/morphology; neutralise unsupported Kuromoji boundaries before lexical reading decisions]
TS3A --> TS4[4 Repair typed temporal-expression boundaries
Recover swallowed temporal suffixes without splitting complete standalone lexical 中-words; mark independently attested span/lexical collisions for review

g.title: TS5
g.text: Recognise normal [temporal head][中] as well as repaired spans; seal the right edge and independently re-evaluate suffix-like lexical followers

g.title: TS6
g.text: 6 Classify one-day date vs duration role
Preserve legitimate calendar `ついたち`; recognise ordinary and サ変+する predicates, including through intervening nominal argument phrases

g.title: TS7
g.text: 7 Type reviewed clock-hour components, then merge complete minute-counter spans
Clock hours use reviewed 0–23 evidence; adjacent hour/minute components remain separate; no generic numeric-pronunciation heuristic

g.title: TS8
g.text: Require independent reading evidence + following case-particle syntax

g.title: TS9
g.text: Strong morphology/contiguity only; punctuation blocks bounded misparse recovery

g.title: TS11
g.text: Retokenise overshooting remainder + protect repaired boundary

g.title: TS13
g.text: 13 Reassemble honorific fragments caused by reviewed boundary repair

g.title: TS20
g.text: 20 Mark unreviewed name-context tokens for audit

g.title: TS34
g.text: Preserve existing numeral + 助数詞 structure; general-word evidence cannot replace it

g.title: TS35
g.text: Token-neighbour feature scores; insufficient margin stays ambiguous

g.title: TS36
g.text: Carry explicit same-word/conjunctive joins while preserving separate auxiliaries

g.title: JHSCOPE
g.text: KANJIDIC + reviewed variant maps + compact reviewed Japanese-use supplement
unique reviewed single-Han reading may resolve; unknown-scope never receives guessed readings

g.title: JHSCOPE->RR0
g.text: consulted only when ordinary reading paths fail

g.title: SENTVERIFY
g.text: All provisional resolutions are considered with the repaired token stream and full source
Only lower-confidence/fallback sources may change, and only to an already-attested contextual candidate
Insufficient full-sentence margin => retain reading + lower confidence + require review

g.title: RAUTH
g.text: Use authoritative reading and/or direct Romaji

g.title: RNUM
g.text: Use canonical reviewed numeric reading/direct Romaji

g.title: RPART
g.text: は→wa / へ→e / を→o only grammatically

g.title: RREN
g.text: Use attested voiced or blocked reading

g.title: NAMERANK
g.text: Kuromoji agreement → unique reading → category hints → source/rank evidence
Ambiguity remains reviewable rather than forced

g.title: KASSESS
g.text: Assess against reading evidence and general-word candidates

g.title: REVID
g.text: printable Romaji does not clear review

g.title: RAMBIG
g.text: Supported single Han may emit top evidence-backed candidate + review

g.title: DIRECT
g.text: Use reviewed/direct Romaji unchanged except later formatting

g.title: TOKGUARD
g.text: Block unresolved Han inside token output

g.title: NASAL
g.text: ん stays n, never automatic m

g.title: NAPOS
g.text: Insert apostrophe before following vowel/y where needed

g.title: LONG
g.text: おう→ou / おお→oo / aa / ii / ee/ei / uu

g.title: JNAME
g.text: Track person-name continuation and name spacing

g.title: JNUM
g.text: Numeric assembly: attach local place-value units, separate completed groups / 円

g.title: SPACE
g.text: Collapse repeated spaces + normalise sentence spacing

g.title: AUD4
g.text: Flags + review-signal candidates: fallback, ambiguity, conflicts, variants, unresolved, etc.

g.title: AUDLIFE
g.text: Resolution refinements carry prior signals forward
Only the uncertainty actually settled by stronger evidence may be superseded; independent ambiguity/conflict/unresolved signals remain active

g.title: AUDCAT
g.text: unresolved Japanese reading/Han vs out-of-scope vs unknown Japanese-scope status

g.title: AUDSTAT
g.text: literal Unresolved count + separate scope counts

g.title: AUD7
g.text: Only final-active signals can require review

g.title: KHELP
g.text: [M04 data + M11 API/UI lifecycle + kanji banks]

g.title: KHELP3
g.text: UI rendering only when a consumer opts in

g.title: KHELP4
g.text: Must not be used to guess a word/name one Kanji at a time
